core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rehman corresponds to the Arabic form رَحْمَان and is glossed in this record as “The Most Merciful.” The record associates the form with root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rehman corresponds to the Arabic form رَحْمَان (Arabic root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m); رَحْمَان (Raḥmān)). Its core sense is rehman; the most merciful. Rehman is a spelling variant of Arabic رَحْمَان (Raḥmān) 'the Most Merciful', from the root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m). The source gloss 'Benevolent, Merciful, Kind' is broadly consistent. Same name as rahman.

etymology.morphology: Built on the root ر ح م.
etymology.etymological_meaning: From the root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m)
etymology.etymology_explanation: The form رَحْمَان is an established Arabic lexical item, and Rehman is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

religion.religious_status: Culturally used; not inherently a doctrinal term
religion.religious_explanation: Rehman is used by Muslims as a personal name, but the word itself is lexical in origin; its Islamic association is cultural rather than scriptural.

quranic_status.note: Rehman is not independently established as a Qur'anic personal name, so no Qur'anic basis is claimed.

islamic_naming_context.context: Muslim naming culture in South Asia and the Persianate world
islamic_naming_context.interpretation: Its lexical sense is a positive quality that families may wish for a child.
islamic_naming_context.important_distinction: Muslim use of the name is not evidence that the word is Qur'anic or religiously prescribed.

cultural_context.cultural_meaning: In the communities that use it, the name reads as a positive quality.
cultural_context.personal_name_interpretation: As a personal name it can be read as a wish for the quality it names.
cultural_context.interpretation_warning: The symbolic reading is a cultural convention, distinct from the dictionary sense.

spiritual_meaning.meaning: Families may read the sense “The Most Merciful” as a hopeful quality for the child.

numerology.meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rehman total 5, associated with change, freedom and adaptability. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

urdu.name: رحمان
urdu.long_meaning: Rehman (رحمان) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم رحمان، بے حد مہربان ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: رحمان
persian.long_meaning: Rehman (رحمان) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن رحمان، بخشنده است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: रहमान
hindi.long_meaning: Rehman (रहमान) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ रहमान, दयालु है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

pashto.name: رحمان
pashto.long_meaning: Rehman (رحمان) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې رحمان، مهربان ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: رَحْمَان
arabic.long_meaning: Rehman (رَحْمَان) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الرَّحْمَان. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.a: Rehman is an Arabic-origin name meaning “The Most Merciful”.

faq.q: What is the origin of Rehman?
faq.a: Rehman originates in Arabic and circulates in Muslim naming communities.
Yes, the recorded form رَحْمَان is Arabic.

faq.q: What is the root of Rehman?
faq.a: It is built on the root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m).
Rehman is used by Muslims, but it is a lexical name rather than an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Rehman is not independently established as a Qur'anic personal name.

faq.q: What does Rehman mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu it is written رحمان and carries the sense “رحمان، بے حد مہربان”.

faq.q: Is Rehman a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records Rehman as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
